Problem Statement
Write a program that takes the marks obtained by a student in three subjects and performs various calculations to analyze the student's performance.
Description
You need to read three integer marks and perform the following operations:
Calculate the total marks obtained.
Calculate the average marks.
Find the difference between the highest and lowest mark.
Calculate the product of the first and second marks.
Display all the results in the specified format.

75
